qualification: Pursuing CS/CE degree with basic proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python
description: Gain hands-on experience building scalable software solutions alongside industry leaders and mentors at Microsoft.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: International graduate students, young professionals, and artists worldwide

description: Enables graduate students and young professionals from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States.

title: Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open globally to professionals with 3+ years of web development experience

description: Work on building intuitive user interface features and modernizing frontend architecture in a 100% remote company.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access

title: Google Summer of Code 2025
eligibility: 18+ years old, student or beginner to open source software development

description: A global online program focused on bringing new contributors into open source software development over 12+ weeks.

title: Associate Data Scientist
